profile.headline: Vice President Lead Software Engineer at JPMorganChase
profile.summary: A driven team player with strong problem solving and communication skills with 5 years of experience in Software Development . Former educator with with attention to detail and an ongoing eagerness to elevate technical skills.

positions.title: Associate Software Engineer
positions.description: Skills: Solution Architecture · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Kubernetes

positions.title: Software Engineer Analyst
positions.description:
Investment Accounting (BOES - Accounting)
•	Automated Trades to be processed to SQL database (Perl)
•	Developed application to automate statutory schedule reconciliation reports reducing manual process time by 50% (Java, Spring, Maven, Mockito, JUnit)
•	Worked with on-boarding trades for Citi Banamex acquisition and assisted with the knowledge transfer 
•	Analyst Alley: Internal Company Network 
         - Organized events catered to analysts to help with professional development and networking   within the company

positions.title: Apprentice Software Developer
positions.description: A comprehensive software development training program with strong emphasis on Test Driven Development, Object Oriented Programming, Agile and Scrum methodologies, and pair coding.

positions.title: Native English Teacher
positions.description:
-Developed an afterschool program called "Global Leadership Program" that involved students learning leadership qualities while learning English
-Guided students in South Korea to develop their understanding of English and increased student's interest and awareness of different cultures
-Modeled proper English pronunciation to students to enhance their speaking abilities
-Conducted co-teaching lessons with the Korean teacher and provided whole and small group lessons when needed
-Created lesson plans to teach South Korean students English vocabulary, grammar as well as the history of the United States and varied topics in culture
-Displayed strong public speaking skills while presenting lesson plans to a classroom of 30 students and a co-teacher

positions.title: Student Teacher
positions.description:
-Observed quality teaching skills and classroom management skills and created and taught lessons in various subjects to a Pre-Kindergarten classroom
-Communicated with families in person and with a weekly newsletter.
-Participated in parent-teacher conferences to discuss student's progress

positions.title: Office Assistant
positions.description:
-Provided customer service to visitors and assisted with projects, data collection, and other related duties as assigned
-Coordinated and maintained records for staff office space, phones  and office keys.
-Created and modified various documents using Microsoft Office, Excel and Publisher.

positions.title: Escapades Expert
positions.description:
-Facilitated therapeutic activities that reflected the interests, values, and beliefs of the residents while providing life-enriching opportunities
-Encouraged socialization, provided entertainment, relaxation and fulfillment, and improved daily living skills of residents
-Organized, lead and promoted interest in recreational activities such as arts, crafts, sports, games, and hobbies
-Enforced regulations of recreational facilities, adhered to company's procedures to ensure safety of all residents

positions.title: Corps Member
positions.description:
-Participated in an award-winning network of volunteers who provide individualized attention and positive adult-child relationships to prepare children attending preschool in low-income neighborhoods for school success
-Implemented early childhood curriculum, supported family involvement, promoted children’s
language and literacy skills through ongoing relationships with 30 partner children, and increased adult support in the learning environment.
-Collaborated with a team 7 Corps members to plan twice weekly in classroom
activities for a class of 18 preschool children.
-Received intensive training and professional development in early childhood theory and practice,
language and literacy development, leadership skills, and communication with families.

positions.title: Owl Orientation Team Leader
positions.description:
-Welcomed new students and parents to campus and served as a positive role model and representative of Temple University
-Introduced students and parents to services, programs, resources, and involvement opportunities available at Temple University
-Helped new students with their individual concerns, both in formal meetings and informally in the halls, dining commons, advising locations, and generally throughout the orientation session
-Prepared new students for a successful transition into the University by acquainting them with the helping resources, physical layout, and administrative procedures, while stressing assertive behaviors

honors.title: The President's Volunteer Service Award- Gold
honors.description: The President’s Volunteer Service Award recognizes United States citizens and lawfully admitted, permanent residents of the United States who have achieved the required number of hours of service over a 12-month time period or cumulative hours over the course of a lifetime.
honors.issuer: Issued by Corporation for National and Community Service · May 2013
